cells.gaps: No source found says Eritrea has a rule in force or in draft on sending personal data abroad.
cells.note: Rescored under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (messages-for-bill 58): A source reviewed on 8 June 2026 says Eritrea has no data protection law and no restriction on cross-border transfer [ERI-002]. That is a dated statement that nothing protects data sent abroad, so the stage is 1.
